name: The Captain's Cutlass
summary: Aboard Smotts' Revenge, Captain Hecklebury Smotts faces defeat at sea once more. Sea giants smash his second ship, kill its crew, and take his cutlass. He sends you to Sprogger, his former cook, to find the behemoth.

sections.title: A Second Calamity
sections.body: After losing his first ship, Captain Hecklebury Smotts bought another and named it Smotts' Revenge. He gathered a new crew and provisions to hunt the sea giants who took his first vessel. The giants smashed the ship and killed the crew. Once more, Smotts was left adrift in a lifeboat, and Negolash took his cutlass in the attack.

sections.title: Consulting the Cook
sections.body: Captain Hecklebury Smotts wants his stolen cutlass back, so he turns to Sprogger. Sprogger was the cook aboard Smotts' Revenge and survived the attack. He can help you track down Negolash.

faq.q: What ship did Captain Hecklebury Smotts lose in this attack?
aliases: what was the second ship called
faq.answer: Captain Hecklebury Smotts bought and outfitted Smotts' Revenge to hunt the sea giants who took his first ship. The giants destroyed that vessel too.
Negolash, one of the sea giants, took the captain's cutlass when the giants smashed Smotts' Revenge and killed its crew.
Sprogger was the cook aboard Smotts' Revenge and survived the attack that destroyed the vessel. Captain Smotts directs you to consult him for help tracking down Negolash.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the hunt for the sea giants?
faq.answer: This step follows The Monogrammed Sash and leads directly to Facing Negolash.
